Interface IStructureEventToggleStart

All Superinterfaces:
IAnimatedArchitectureEvent, IStructureToggleEvent
All Known Implementing Classes:
StructureEventToggleStart
public interface IStructureEventToggleStart extends IStructureToggleEvent
Represents a toggle action that will be applied to a structure.If you want to cancel the action, use IStructureEventTogglePrepare instead.

  • Method Details

    • getStructure

      Structure getStructure()
      Gets the structure that is the subject of this event.

      Note that this structure is not the same as the structure in the snapshot. The snapshot contains the old data of the structure before the animation was applied. The structure, however, may already have been modified.

      Returns:
      The structure.
